prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a preschool listening picture-card game
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only; match its flat picture-book rendering, warm pale background, rounded shapes, color polish, and smooth navy outline weight, but do not copy any animal.
Primary request: create one polished wide 3:2 illustration sheet containing exactly six isolated toy picture-card subjects in this exact left-to-right row order.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform warm pale cream background across the whole sheet, with broad empty gutters separating every cell.
Subject: top row, left to right: one colorful toy ball; one small red toy car with no driver; one unmistakable soft cloth doll shown as a toy, not a living person. Bottom row, left to right: one diamond-shaped kite with a short curled tail; one compact group of three plain building blocks with blank faces; one friendly teddy bear.
Style/medium: consistent flat picture-book illustration for young children; simple rounded shapes; clean solid color fills; subtle paper-like softness; strong smooth navy outlines of equal visual weight.
Composition/framing: rigid 3-column by 2-row grid on a wide 3:2 canvas; six equal cells; each subject fully contained, isolated, centered, similarly scaled, and surrounded by generous breathing room; clear empty separation and outer margins; no subject crosses a cell boundary.
Lighting/mood: bright, gentle, cheerful, calm, non-frightening.
Constraints: exactly one named toy subject per cell and exactly six subjects total; the three blocks together count as one grouped subject; preserve the exact ordering; no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, divider text, logos, signatures, or watermark; no people; no hands holding toys; no drivers; no scenes, floors, rooms, roads, sky, clouds, furniture, containers, props, or extra objects; no cell borders that touch a subject.
Avoid: a doll that looks like a real child; duplicate toys; extra balls or vehicles; branded toy designs; cropped subjects; adjacent-cell leakage; photorealism; 3D rendering; clutter; artifacts; frightening expressions.
